symbols.name: family parameter
symbols.meaning: A nonnegative integer that indexes the members of the family.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta$ be a nonnegative integer, the family parameter, and let $C_\theta$ be the member of the family built with parameter $\theta$.

symbols.name: family member
symbols.meaning: The construction in the family built with parameter $\theta$, which takes exactly $2^\theta$ input entries.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta$ be a nonnegative integer, the family parameter, and let $C_\theta$ be the member of the family built with parameter $\theta$.

relations.quote: A family parameter sets the sizes of the calls of the [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md).
